project_context.name: Portal Desa Digital
project_context.type: Hybrid Fullstack (Public Civic Portal + Admin CMS)

theme_and_colors.archetype: Organic & Earthy (Arch Type 1) mixed with Swiss High-Contrast for Data
rules: Never use pure black #000000 or pure grey. Tint darks with deep green/brown.
No full-screen gradients. Use solid colors and subtle noise textures for depth.
Seasonal themes should be implemented as CSS classes (.theme-lebaran, .theme-agustus) applied to the body or root wrapper, altering CSS variables.
BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans for headings.
Headings must use tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em).
Data tables must use monospaced fonts for numerical alignment.

grid_systems.public_portal: Mode A: 'Tetris' Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, gap-8 to gap-12) for News and Home.
grid_systems.admin_dashboard: Mode B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4, tight gap-4) for CMS and Financial Analytics.

rules: Generous spacing: Use 2-3x more padding than usual for public pages (e.g., py-24 for sections).
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
Mobile-first responsive. Images max-h-[80vh] on mobile.

headers.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-black/5
headers.rule: Never use fully transparent header. Content must not be obscured.

financial_tables.rules: No alternating row colors. Use 1px light bottom border per row. Fixed sticky headers. 32-36px row heights.

buttons.style: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-full or rounded-lg)
buttons.interaction: Must explicitly set hover text color. e.g., hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white

rules: Use Shadcn UI (heavily customized) for Admin forms, modals, tables, and tabs.
Use custom raw HTML/Tailwind for Public Home, Gallery, and News layouts to avoid rigid structural constraints.

interactions_and_motion.animation: Minimal but deliberate. Smooth entrances (opacity + slight Y-translate) for lists and gallery items.
interactions_and_motion.performance: Crucial for slow networks. Implement Lazy Loading for all gallery images. Use React Suspense.
rules: Exclude transforms from universal transition (no 'transition: all').

media_and_images.galleries: Use Lightbox pattern for the 'Galeri per acara' feature.

landscape.description: Aerial view of green valley (Footer or Section Break)

media_and_images.rules: Never use placeholder images. Max overlay opacity bg-black/40.

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive/key elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over images MUST have text-shadow or a gradient overlay to meet WCAG AA.
accessibility_and_testing.multi_language: Provide clear toggle (ID/EN). Ensure UI doesn't break with longer English words.

instructions_to_main_agent: Override tailwind.config.js to set the base theme and extend with the custom 'netral', 'lebaran', and 'agustus17' theme colors as CSS variables.
Create a ThemeContext in React to handle the seasonal toggle which swaps out CSS variables on the root.
Implement language translation context (ID/EN) wrapping the app.
Use Shadcn UI for the Admin CMS, but strip the default look to match the Earthy Organic brand (e.g. adjust border radius and spacing).
For the public 'Laporan Keuangan' (Financial Report) page, prioritize scannability and build a clean, transparent table UI with a PDF export button.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop aesthetics. Build creative, distinctive frontends.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is BANNED).
NEVER use emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder image text. Use the provided URLs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle borders.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
